data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002's CRT derivation of the general solution class n≡18 mod 35 depends on SRC_004's counterfactual analysis: SRC_004 explicitly identifies that the remainders differ from their divisors by unequal amounts (-2 vs -3), breaking the constant-residue shortcut, which is precisely the logical step that forces the algebraic CRT path SRC_002 uses. The causal mechanism is that the disanalogy in remainder-offsets (diagnosed by SRC_004) is what necessitates the modular-inverse computation that SRC_002 performs to unify the congruences into x≡18 mod 35. REFUTED IF: SRC_004's offset disanalogy does not actually constrain the method choice (i.e., the CRT algebraic path works equally well when offsets are equal), or if the modular inverse of 5 mod 7 is not 3, which would break the derivation SRC_002 inherits.
